purpose: Validate end-to-end KLD coalition interactions and the direct-KLD Shapley estimator before building the 42-layer P8/MXFP8 ladder.
role: already-opened conditional-fit n=32 adaptive development role

game.base: matched decoded full-Hessian GPTQ NVFP4 BF16 reconstruction at all four layers
game.candidate: replace coalition layers with their frozen decoded K4 procedural-MCG P8 BF16 reconstruction
game.execution: all arms use zero-copy BF16 overlays and the same InstantTensor/framework path
game.interpretation: interaction/estimator pilot only; not the final native P8-to-MXFP8 6-bpw game and not a kernel result

primary_estimand: For each layer and window, average of its two contextual reductions KLD(before coalition) minus KLD(after adding layer) along the antithetic paths.

decision_rule.estimator_integrity: Every coalition must contain the identical 32 windows and domains and each path's maximum absolute window-level Shapley efficiency residual must be <= 1e-12.
decision_rule.interaction_interpretation: Report both contextual marginals, their averaged per-window marginal, sign, ranking, BCa interval, domains, and window wins. Intervals are controls and do not veto development.
decision_rule.scale_up: Proceed to the native 42-layer game only after estimator integrity passes; this pilot does not select or qualify a final codec.

stopping_rule: Run every one of the eight unique coalitions once; resume incomplete windows only; no exclusions, substitutions, or rerolls.
protected_boundary: Selection, confirmation, final, and all reserved 28 confirmation logits remain unopened.
